source: Personal Dev (org trov-dev), read 2026-10-15 through the Trov MCP read tools (list_docs, get_feed) — docs as live (version 1, promoted 2026-10-09), feed entries #108-#124 as written. READ ONLY.

entries.author: andres
entries.summary: Shipped: PR #176 opens — summaries move from Gemini to Claude Haiku 5.5 behind a provider-agnostic client
entries.brief: Pull request and issue summaries now go through one model client (Claude Haiku 5.5), the base every later AI feature will use. Same fields and storage, no migration; waits on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and a merge.

entries.author: andres
entries.summary: Status: AI base (#177) and the AI screens frontend (#178) are open, stacked on #176, all green
entries.brief: The AI groundwork is ready for review: a monthly AI allowance, an org AI switch, an empty AI pass in the cron, suggestions and "Wrong?" feedback, and the four new AI screens built but hidden until something writes their content.

entries.author: andres
entries.summary: Status: server-side AI Phase A landed on PR #178 (Jev as a provider, Sift under the org switch, ai_chat allowance, Org settings › AI)
entries.brief: Trov's AI now has one client with two providers, Sift obeys the org's AI switch, and Org settings › AI shows every AI allowance and both providers.

entries.author: andres
entries.summary: Repo setups Phase 0: Org settings › Hosting shows one card per provider; old per-environment Railway tokens are leftovers, not connections
entries.brief: Fixed the three-Railway-cards bug: one status function for every hosting surface, leftovers shown inside the card with Remove old tokens, and Integrations / Hosting / Environments each own one thing.

entries.author: andres
entries.summary: Status: server-side AI Phase B landed on PR #178 (router, scopes, the pass, batches) plus the plain-language filter
entries.brief: Every write now marks what it made stale, and the AI pass has its machinery (debounce, grouping, gates, caching, batches); the plain-language filter works on Tickets, the Feed and Artifacts.

entries.author: andres
entries.summary: Repo setups Phase A: apps (repo_apps), a credential-less GitHub hosting provider, and a commit on every deploy or an honest NULL
entries.brief: 0070_repo_apps adds apps and deploy provenance; GitHub deploy signals are captured again; Cloudflare reads commits from Workers Builds; others join one GitHub signal within 10 minutes or stay NULL; rollbacks detected by one compare.

entries.author: andres
entries.summary: Repo setups Phase C: the Repo Overview drawn from RepoFacts with the design's blocks, header, Group by and a scenario switch
entries.brief: The Overview is now composed per the shared layout rules: attention, connect card, the rule-picked opener (production/previews, env cards/drift, apps table, release, found, unseen), not shipped, week, links. Verdict: Healthy only on passing checks, else Live.

entries.author: andres
entries.summary: Repo setups Phases B2, D, F: the server facts read (live repos get the new Overview), app detection + Org settings › Repositories › Apps, and releases
entries.brief: RepoFacts served by GET /repo/dashboard and MCP with the shared layout; repo scan + detectors + suggestions (accept/ignore/undo) and the Apps setup screen; releases captured through the gate with feat-only feature claims; Poll now cap 50 -> 100.

entries.author: andres
entries.summary: Repo setups Phase G: Usage reads metric families; Cloudflare outcomes / runtime / D1 / crons; app metrics v3 and Trov's own /api/internal/metrics
entries.brief: Usage tab is a card per target in one of four states; Cloudflare extras use real invocation-outcome names (no invented 4xx/5xx); v3 self-described metrics; Trov's own endpoint on the existing bearer class (CLAUDE.md invariant 8 wording updated, pending Andres's confirmation).
